import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt
from makemarket.scoring import episode_metrics, bootstrap_ci, paired_ratio_ci

path = Path('results/validation/qwen38_serial_sft_grpo_dice.json')
assert not path.exists()
plan_path = Path('results/training/qwen38_seed1_early_stop_ablation_plan.json')
plan = json.loads(plan_path.read_text())
assert plan['paired_interval_policy']['family_contrasts'] == 10
inputs, values, summaries = {}, {}, {}
training = Path('results/kaggle/qwen38-round3-training-v5')
assert json.loads((training / 'runtime.json').read_text())['seed'] == 0
for method, directory in [('sft', 'warmstart_adapter'), ('grpo', 'lora_adapter')]:
    label = f'qwen3.8-27b-{method}'
    root = Path(f'results/kaggle/qwen38-primary-{method}-validation-v1') / label
    raw = root / f'results/raw/dice/{label}.jsonl'
    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in raw.read_text().splitlines()]
    assert [r['seed'] for r in rows] == list(range(80000, 80100))
    adapter_hash = file_sha256(training / directory / 'adapter_model.safetensors')
    for row in rows:
        cfg = row['provenance']['config']
        assert cfg['seed'] == 0 and cfg['eval_batch_size'] == 1 and cfg['adapter_sha256'] == adapter_hash
    values[method] = np.array([episode_metrics(r)['epnl'] for r in rows])
    scores = root / 'results/leaderboard_dice.json'
    summaries[method] = next(r for r in json.loads(scores.read_text())['rows'] if r['player'] == label)
    for p in (raw, scores, root / 'runtime.json'):
        inputs[str(p)] = file_sha256(p)
bayes = Path('results/kaggle/qwen38-primary-sft-validation-v1/qwen3.8-27b-sft/results/raw/dice/bayes.jsonl')
reference = np.array([episode_metrics(json.loads(line))['epnl'] for line in bayes.read_text().splitlines()])
inputs[str(bayes)] = file_sha256(bayes)
delta = values['grpo'] - values['sft']
record = {'provenance': receipt({'purpose': 'preregistered primary serial GRPO minus SFT dice validation contrast', 'family_contrasts': 10, 'bootstrap_seed': 0, 'family_draws': 40000}, plan['provenance']['model_revision']),
          'source': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'plan_file': str(plan_path), 'plan_sha256': file_sha256(plan_path),
          'input_sha256': inputs, 'seeds': list(range(80000, 80100)), 'summaries': summaries,
          'grpo_minus_sft_expected_pnl': float(delta.mean()), 'paired_95_ci': bootstrap_ci(delta),
          'paired_family_ci': bootstrap_ci(delta, level=.995, n_boot=40000),
          'percentage_point_difference_family': paired_ratio_ci(delta, reference, level=.995, n_boot=40000),
          'scope': 'Validation only, registered ten-contrast family. One primary training seed and frozen serial inference. Incomplete cards remain unscored; neither native adapter can replace the already frozen batch-four SFT test policy.'}
path.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
print({k: record[k] for k in ('grpo_minus_sft_expected_pnl', 'paired_95_ci', 'paired_family_ci')})
